item.title: Democrats Report Strong Numbers Ahead of 2026 Midterms
item.description: Data: FEC, Axios research. Chart: Noah Bressner/Axios. If money is momentum, Democratic Senate candidates are poised for a monumental Election Day.

item.title: Geothermal energy gains bipartisan support amid AI expansion
item.description: Geothermal power, drawn from the Earth's natural heat, is attracting support across the political spectrum in a polarized America.

item.title: Banks pull back as AI debt diverges from economic reality
item.description: Wall Street appears to be reaching its limit on AI, with financiers increasingly voicing concerns that the spending does not match economic fundamentals.

item.title: Maine Senate debate turns heated
item.description: Maine Republican Sen. Susan Collins and Democratic challenger Troy Jackson clashed in a tense debate Thursday night when a protester interrupted loudly.
